sources.title: Piracy monthly report June 2025
sources.text: Five robbers armed with knives boarded a ship underway and entered the engine room. Duty engineer noticed the robbers and informed the bridge. General alarm sounded and PA announcements made. A thorough search was conducted and ship's engine spares identified as stolen. Upon arrival at the anchorage, Singapore Police Coast Guard boarded the ship for investigation.
